apiDesignReferences.use: Design context for discarded prioritized-task experiment
Design context; no shared task-yield change accepted

decisions: The original scheduler is retained. Final normal production bytes are identical to the parent accepted release.
MessageChannel task coalescing passed controlled withheld-frame, Undo and supersession tests but did not improve real clicks and worsened typing controls; rejected and fully reverted.
The separate timeline records delayed MessageChannel delivery. Its cause is unproven; a delayed callback alone does not establish that the application chose the wrong scheduling policy.

Feature-detected user-blocking postTask also did not improve real font clicks; rejected and fully reverted. The proposed missing/rejected-API fixtures compiled but were not run; no compatibility acceptance is claimed.
Experimental renderer/scheduling requirements and tests were removed. Archived exact source preimages and bundles describe discarded proposals, not current contracts.

Initial controlled pixel assertions omitted Canvas copy/premultiplication stages. A separate three-surface native composition corrected the reference; the corrected controlled MessageChannel tests and prioritized-task focused pair passed. Their scheduler changes are still rejected on actual workflow evidence.
The initial summary script assumed one attachment shape; it was corrected to handle lists and phase availability. Raw reports remain authoritative.
limits: No latency improvement is claimed this turn.
The total p95 and long-task budgets remain unmet.
No physical-display, hardware-GPU, tablet, sustained/editor-wide or process-peak memory acceptance.

The full original typography/fonts/shaping, color/precision/interchange/photographic, AI/provider/evaluation, catalog/workflow/collaboration/commercial/enterprise/specialist/motion, T23 installed/model-driven and T24 eligible registered live-provider gates remain active.

method.fontCase: 12 real swaps, approximately 1000 characters per layer, 800x600 document
method.longTasks: Surrounding observed workflow, including preparation/UI work; not only the model command
method.phaseMeaning: Click-to-prepare includes command and UI work; command marker is a nested interval. Wait + prepare + post-prepare copy equals total for the same matching-state frame.
method.presentation: Canvas-copy proxy behind the open dialog, not physical display
method.profileAndTrace: Separate diagnostic runs with instrumentation overhead; not substituted for unprofiled acceptance
method.quantiles: Nearest-rank p95; no filtering or pooling

scope: F14 phase measurement and rejected scheduling experiments; no accepted product runtime change; full original roadmap goal remains active

verification.discardedRuns: Intermediate unit/browser successes belong to rejected source stages and are retained separately from final acceptance.
verification.finalBuild: npm run build passed actual WASM, isolated runtime, plugin/site/docs generation, TypeScript and normal production bundling
verification.pngBoundary: Six new native font-workflow images compared to six previously accepted production images, not a production rerun.
